placements.title: calibration and verification as recorded organizational practice
placements.frame: What instrument calibration and verification activities does this organization perform, and how are they recorded as authoritative?
placements.why: Both expressions concern instrument calibration and its verification — the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibrated at 88.4 MHz and verified against June reference plates. This names an organizational category for calibration activities that future envelopes will continue to feed.

placements.title: calibration authority established by verification against reference standards, not bare assertion
placements.frame: How is instrument calibration authority established and recorded through appeal to a named verification standard?
placements.why: Both expressions perform the same thematic move: asserting a settled calibration state by deferring to the June reference plates as the benchmark that legitimates it. src-1 carries Quill's reported speech in native technical vocabulary — frequency value, observing band, verification chain — while src-2 compresses the same claim into a decision-log entry. The shared theme is calibration authority constituted through benchmark verification and then recorded as load-bearing fact; the register difference is the same stance at two levels, not a disagreement.
